fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $30,000 for new franchisees. Existing franchisees signing an additional Publisher Agreement pay a reduced fee of $20,000. The fee is fully earned upon signing the Publisher Agreement and is generally non-refundable, except that under a Deposit and Non-Disclosure Agreement, the fee less $1,500 may be refunded if the franchisee fails to complete Initial Training or notifies the franchisor within 5 days of completing training that they do not intend to proceed.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $30,000 ("Franchise Fee").  If you are an existing franchisee signing an additional Publisher Agreement, you must pay us a Franchise Fee of $20,000.
